language.generalAdvisory: High Value Capital Group provides advisory, documentation, preparation, coordination, and strategic support services. HVCG is not a law firm, CPA firm, insurance agency, mortgage broker, real estate brokerage, investment bank, securities broker-dealer, or licensed lender unless separately stated in writing.
language.financing: Financing outcomes are determined by third-party lenders and capital providers. HVCG does not guarantee approval, terms, or funding.
language.legalSensitive: HVCG may organize documentation and coordinate with licensed counsel. HVCG does not provide legal advice or act as an attorney.
language.taxMatters: HVCG may prepare documentation and coordinate with CPAs or tax counsel. HVCG does not provide tax opinions or act as a CPA unless separately stated in writing.
language.insuranceReview: HVCG may help organize policies and loss documentation. HVCG does not sell, bind, or conclusively determine insurance coverage.
language.mortgageRealEstate: HVCG may organize owner documentation for mortgage or real-estate readiness. HVCG is not a mortgage broker or real-estate brokerage unless separately stated in writing.
language.estateTrust: HVCG may organize documents and coordinate professionals for estate/trust matters. HVCG does not provide estate planning legal advice.
language.hrTermination: HVCG may support documentation and process organization. Employment decisions require authorized human review and, where appropriate, employment counsel. HVCG does not make protected-class employment decisions.
language.claimsRecovery: HVCG may support claims documentation and recovery coordination. Outcomes are not guaranteed. Licensed professionals may be required.
language.aiSystems: AI-generated information is provided for workflow and decision-support purposes. Authorized human review is required for legal, financial, tax, HR, insurance, lending, investor, government, contractual, or other consequential decisions.

outOfScopeStructured: Services not specifically listed in this scope are excluded and may be quoted separately as a special project or billed at the applicable premium advisory rate.
outOfScopeRetainer: Legal, tax, insurance, HR, lending, disputes, claims, and executive concierge work outside the defined retainer may require a separate project, premium hourly billing, or a replenishing retainer.
